scenario: An insurance adjuster reviews a cyber-liability claim submitted by a policyholder following a reported data security incident. The NLP Toolkit analyzes the incident narrative to produce a structured incident classification (type, scope, affected-records category, severity label). The Insurance Claims Processor adjudicates coverage and produces a reserve estimate and settlement recommendation based on that classification. The Reporting skill then compiles the full adjudication output into a formal claim recommendation report.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes the incident narrative text and produces a structured cyber-incident classification (incident_type, affected_records_category, severity_label, coverage_trigger) → afrexai-insurance-claims uses those classification fields to determine coverage applicability, liability score, and reserve range → reporting generates a formal claim recommendation report to /workspace/output/.
